PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(pnpm( run)? dev|uv run uvicorn)"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2
echo '[Hook] Use this command instead:' >&2
echo "[Hook] tmux new-session -d -s dev 'pnpm dev'" >&2
echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
echo '[Hook] Review changes before push...' >&2
echo '[Hook] Press Enter to continue or Ctrl+C to abort...' >&2
read -r

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
echo "[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary doc file: $file_path" >&2
echo "[Hook] Use README.md instead" >&2
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output // ""')
pr_url=$(echo "$output" | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+')
if [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
  echo "[Hook] PR created: $pr_url" >&2
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file_path")
  project_root="$dir"
  while [ "$project_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$project_root/package.json" ]; do
    project_root=$(dirname "$project_root")
  done
  if [ -f "$project_root/tsconfig.json" ]; then
    cd "$project_root" && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | grep "$file_path" | head -5 >&2 || true
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file_path")
  project_root="$dir"
  while [ "$project_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$project_root/pyproject.toml" ]; do
    project_root=$(dirname "$project_root")
  done
  if [ -f "$project_root/pyproject.toml" ]; then
    cd "$project_root" && uv run ruff check "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -10 >&2 || true
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  if grep -n "console\.log" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: console.log found in $file_path" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  if grep -n "^[[:space:]]*print(" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: print() found in $file_path" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  modified=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
  js_files=$(echo "$modified" | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' || true)
  py_files=$(echo "$modified" | grep -E '\.py$' || true)
  
  if [ -n "$js_files" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q "console\.log" "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "[Hook] console.log in $f" >&2
    done <<< "$js_files"
  fi
  
  if [ -n "$py_files" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q "^[[:space:]]*print(" "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "[Hook] print() in $f" >&2
    done <<< "$py_files"
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

Stop.description: Final check for console.log/print before session ends
